children.value: > Fact From Story: The voices of a number of well-known recording artists signed to Warner Music Group and Universal Music Group are on the Dream Track experiment.
> > Fact From Story: Something conspicuous is not on there: any endorsement whatsoever from the world’s second-biggest recording company, Sony Music Entertainment, or its artists.
> > Fact From Story: YouTube unveiled a new experiment – ‘Dream Track’ – enabling creators to clone the vocals, via AI tech and with official consent, of well-known stars.
> > Fact From Story: Sony Music's artists aren't involved in YouTube's new voice-cloning AI experiment.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Sony Music is a major record label, like Warner Music Group and Universal Music Group.
